prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-05):
| Return 3m            | +17.7% |
| Return 1m            | +9.7% |
| Return 1w            | +10.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 94% |
| 21d realized vol     | 31% |
| Last close           | 283.50 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has exhibited strong short- to medium-term momentum with 3-month (+17.7%), 1-month (+9.7%), and 1-week (+10.7%) gains, and a recent close near the upper end of its trading range (range position at 94%). Although volatility is elevated (21d realized vol ~31%), the persistent uptrend suggests continued upside over the next ~20 trading days.

DECISION: BUY
